repos.description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
repos.intro: Open Code Review is an AI-powered code review CLI tool. It originated as Alibaba Group's internal official AI code review assistant — over the past two years, it has served tens of thousands of developers and identified millions of code defects.
features: Incomplete coverage — On larger changesets, agents tend to "cut corners," selectively reviewing only some files and missing others.
Position drift — Reported issues frequently don't match the actual code location, with line numbers or file references drifting off target.
Unstable quality — Natural-language-driven Skills are hard to debug, and review quality fluctuates significantly with minor prompt variation…
repos.description_zh: 安全、快速、高效，並在 Alibaba 的規模下經過實戰測試。混合架構程式碼審查工具：確定性 pipeline + LLM Agent，精確的行級評論，內建多語言規則集（NPE、thread-safety、XSS、SQL injection），相容 OpenAI 與 Anthropic。
repos.intro_zh: Open Code Review 是一款由 AI 驅動的程式碼審查 CLI 工具。它起源於 Alibaba Group 的內部官方 AI 程式碼審查助手 —— 在過去兩年中，它已為數萬名開發者提供服務，並識別出數百萬個程式碼缺陷。
features_zh: 覆蓋率不完整 —— 在較大的 changeset 上，agent 往往會「偷工減料」，選擇性地僅審查部分檔案而遺漏其他檔案。
位置偏移 —— 回報的問題經常與實際程式碼位置不符，行號或檔案引用會發生偏移。
品質不穩定 —— 由自然語言驅動的 Skills 難以除錯，且審查品質會隨著微小的 prompt 變化而大幅波動……
repos.description_src: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.

repos.description: Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices
repos.intro: This repo is the source repository for GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance and includes the code and documentation for authoring, calibrating, and evaluating its contents.
features: Modern Browser APIs : Helping models correctly structure APIs they frequently misuse.
Performance & Accessibility : Preferring platform-level APIs that can be optimized by the browser and include built-in accessibility afforda…
Responsible Fallbacks : Guiding models to use sensible, lightweight fallbacks instead of heavy polyfills or legacy libraries.
repos.description_zh: 讓您的 coding agent 掌握最新的 Web 最佳實踐
repos.intro_zh: 此 repo 是 GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance 的原始碼儲存庫，包含用於撰寫、校準與評估其內容的程式碼與文件。
features_zh: Modern Browser APIs：幫助模型正確建構它們經常誤用的 API。
Performance & Accessibility：優先使用可由瀏覽器優化並包含內建無障礙功能（accessibility affordance）的平台級 API。
Responsible Fallbacks：引導模型使用合理且輕量化的 fallback，而非沉重的 polyfills 或舊版函式庫（legacy libraries）。
repos.description_src: Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices

Validate candidate findings, generate patches, and verify existing fixes.
Draft SECURITY.md policies and save threat models for later review.
Browse saved scans and findings, identify duplicates, assess severity against your own rubric, and suggest owners from source and Git histor…
Preview third-party scanner findings, save them locally, or publish supported reports to Codex Security Cloud. Scanner import guides .
Track findings in Linear, Jira, or GitHub, publish completed scans, or export SARIF, JSON, and CSV. Integration workflows .

預覽第三方 scanner 的結果、將其儲存至本地，或將支援的報告發佈到 Codex Security Cloud。Scanner 匯入指南。
在 Linear、Jira 或 GitHub 中追蹤結果、發佈已完成的掃描，或匯出 SARIF、JSON 與 CSV。整合工作流程。
repos.description_src: OpenAI's Codex Security CLI and TypeScript SDK for finding, validating, and fixing security vulnerabilities. npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@openai/codex-security

repos.description: The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click.
repos.intro: Everything you need to annotate and stay in the loop with your agents Inbox Surface • Artifacts • Code Review Annotate plans, specs, markdown, HTML, and other interactive artifacts. Review diffs and PRs. Send feedback to your agent.
features: URL annotation fetches the requested site, through Jina Reader by default for public pages or directly when Jina is disabled or unavailable.
GitHub and GitLab review uses your authenticated CLI and Git remote to retrieve PR or MR data.
Ask AI and review agents send the selected question and relevant plan, document, repository, or diff context to your configured provider.
Sharing sends the complete link to whoever or whatever service you use to deliver it.
Workspaces is a separate hosted product, so the open source app's local-storage model does not apply to content placed there.
repos.description_zh: 讓您能掌握 Agent 動態並參與其中的工作空間 —— 進行塑造、決策、規劃、註解、審查程式碼、與團隊分享，並能一鍵將所有回饋傳送給 Agent。
repos.intro_zh: 您進行註解並與 Agent 保持同步所需的一切。收件匣介面 • Artifacts • Code Review。註解計畫、規格、markdown、HTML 以及其他互動式 Artifacts。審查 diffs 與 PRs。將回饋傳送給您的 Agent。
features_zh: URL 註解預設會透過 Jina Reader 抓取公開網頁的請求內容，若停用或無法使用 Jina 時，則會直接抓取。
GitHub 與 GitLab 審查會使用您已驗證的 CLI 與 Git remote 來取得 PR 或 MR 資料。
Ask AI 與審查 Agent 會將選定的問題以及相關的計畫、文件、repository 或 diff context 傳送至您配置的 provider。
分享功能會將完整的連結傳送給您用來交付的對象或服務。
Workspaces 是一個獨立的託管產品，因此開源應用程式的 local-storage 模型並不適用於存放於該處的內容。
repos.description_src: The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click.

repos.description: like netcat, but over Tailscale's data plane, without Tailscale's control plane
repos.intro: Tailcat is a remix of Tailscale open source pieces to act like netcat , but over Tailscale's data plane, without Tailscale's control plane. Tailscale's data plane ( magicsock , internally) gives you point-to-point WireGuard®-encrypted tunnels between two machines with DERP as the NAT-hole-punching communication side ch…
features: Ephemeral keys (the default): each server run generates a fresh key in memory and prints an address nobody has ever seen.
Saved keys: tailcat genkey generates a key saved to disk so the address stays stable across restarts.
repos.description_zh: 類似 netcat，但運行於 Tailscale 的 data plane 之上，且不使用 Tailscale 的 control plane
repos.intro_zh: Tailcat 是將 Tailscale 的開源組件重新混合，使其運作起來像 netcat，但運行於 Tailscale 的 data plane 之上，且不使用 Tailscale 的 control plane。Tailscale 的 data plane（內部為 magicsock）能為兩台機器提供點對點的 WireGuard® 加密隧道，並以 DERP 作為 NAT 穿透（NAT-hole-punching）的通訊輔助通道...
features_zh: Ephemeral keys（預設值）：每次執行伺服器都會在記憶體中產生一個全新的 key，並印出一個從未有人見過的位址。
Saved keys：tailcat genkey 會產生一個儲存於磁碟中的 key，讓位址在重新啟動後仍能保持穩定。
repos.description_src: like netcat, but over Tailscale's data plane, without Tailscale's control plane
